readback.name: Poincare.BufferedTensorGraphTransport.exists_destination_entry_transport
readback.mathematical_statement: Let E3 be EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3), the real three-dimensional Euclidean vector space. For every universe u, let M : Type u have a topology, an E3 charted-space structure, and the C-infinity IsManifold structure for the boundaryless closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3, and let A : AtlasData M. This atlas data includes finitely many genuine extended charts C_k, open subordinate regions covering M with closures in their chart sources and compact coordinate images, and a smooth partition of unity p_k. No Hausdorff, CompactSpace, connectedness, metric, or physical-flow hypothesis is explicitly assumed. Fix chart indices i,j, scalar functions theta,xi : E3 -> R, a total map F : E3 -> E3, and destination component indices c,d : Fin 3. Assume theta is globally C-infinity and has compact topological support, xi is globally C-infinity, and F is globally C-infinity with compact topological support. C-infinity means the ENat top injected into WithTop ENat. Topological support is the closure of the nonzero set. Assume tsupport(theta) is contained in source(C_i.symm.trans C_j), requiring supported coordinates z to be in target(C_i) with C_i.symm(z) in source(C_j). Let T_ij(z) = C_j(C_i.symm(z)), the pinned change A i j, so its direction is i coordinates to j coordinates. Assume at every z in tsupport(theta) that F agrees with T_ij on a full ambient E3 neighborhood of z, using nhds z, not a within-support filter. Finally assume theta equals one pointwise on K_ij = C_i image (tsupport(p_i) intersect (C_j.symm image tsupport(xi))). This last condition is pointwise equality, not a cutoff-one germ. There is no compact-support or target-support hypothesis on xi, no interval range hypothesis on theta or xi, and no injectivity, invertibility, linearity, or affine requirement on F. For every real alpha with 0 < alpha < 1, there exists a real C >= 0 such that for every T with 0 < T <= 1, there exists a continuous real-linear map B from the nine-component family space (Fin 3 times Fin 3) -> Graph alpha T to Graph alpha T, with operator norm at most C. The input has the existing finite Pi norm, namely the maximum of the nine component Graph norms, rather than a new sum norm on the family. The output has the original Graph norm, the sum of its u,ut,du,ddu Y norms. Each Y norm is the value supremum plus the alpha-Hoelder seminorm within the cylinder Icc 0 T times all of E3, using parabolic distance norm(x-y) + sqrt(abs(t-s)), and each Y field is zero outside that cylinder. The bound C can depend on the previously fixed geometric data, scalar functions, map, indices, and alpha, but is chosen before T and is uniform for 0 < T <= 1 and all input families w. No operator or norm bound is supplied as a hypothesis. The output is an actual Graph, so it includes zero initial u trace, genuine ordinary spatial derivative certificates u -> du -> ddu at every point for times in Icc 0 T, and the within-Icc 0 T time derivative certificate u -> ut. These certificates do not assert an ordinary ambient time derivative at the endpoints or ordinary joint C3 regularity at zero. For every arbitrary input family w of nine Graphs and every p = (t,z) in the entire ambient product, (B w).u(t,z) equals the double sum over a,b : Fin 3 of W_abcd(z) * (w(a,b)).u(t,F(z)), where W_abcd(z) = theta(z) * (p_i(C_i.symm(z)) * xi(F(z)) * (DF_z(e_c))_a * (DF_z(e_d))_b) is the pinned scalar weight. All these products and the double sum are ordinary real multiplication and addition. For every w, every real t, and every z outside coordSupport A i = C_i image tsupport(p_i), the output u(t,z) is zero. For every w, every real t, and every x in source(C_i), the output u(t,C_i(x)) equals p_i(x) times a source-indicated expression. If x is in source(C_j), that expression is the double sum over a,b of xi(C_j(x)) * J_ij(x)_(a,c) * J_ij(x)_(b,d) * (w(a,b)).u(t,C_j(x)); otherwise it is zero. Here J_ij(x)_(a,c) = jac A i j x a c = (D(T_ij) at C_i(x), applied to basis vector e_c)_a. Thus a,b are output indices in j coordinates and source-field slots, while c,d are input indices in i coordinates and destination-field slots. The explicit @ite with Classical.propDecidable is the real-valued indicator branch for membership in source(C_j). Only destination partition p_i appears; no source partition p_j factor is introduced. The raw formula, support statement, and chart formula are asserted for all real evaluation times, not only within the time cylinder, with the zero extensions ensuring consistency outside it. The input family is arbitrary and need not satisfy spatial support, symmetry, overlap, or a source-partition weighting condition. The literal output formulas specify u only; no separate explicit ut,du,ddu component identities or support equations are asserted, although output Graph membership supplies the derivative certificates. This theorem constructs one destination scalar entry for one fixed chart pair. It does not sum over source charts, assemble a global tensor, establish symmetry or transition compatibility, construct a DeTurck L/P/R identity, assert a contraction norm, or produce Ricci flow or Hamilton convergence.
